from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=4,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_WORKER_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_WORKER_PROMPT_B, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_WORKER_PROMPT_C, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_WORKER_PROMPT_D],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_AGGREGATOR_PROMPT,
        )
        draft = await star(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_REFINE_PROMPT_1, prompt_custom.COUNTDOWN_REFINE_PROMPT_2])
        solution = await seq(problem + "\n\nCandidate answer:\n" + (draft.get("response") or "```text\ncannot form target\n```"))
        return solution.get("response") or "```text\ncannot form target\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
